criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Per frame 1=7.0, 2=7.0, 3=6.8, 4=6.3, 5=7.3, 6=7.3, 7=7.8, 8=6.5, 9=7.2. Repairs real but partial: 2's shelter now spans about 60 percent and the mesa is gone, but the navy wash still reads as a plate; 1 has regional albedo but the sheet reads as clear glass with no gold; 9 has a town but the outline renders salmon and lips smear; 4 still reads as glossy UI buttons with a shadow lump outside the rail; 3 still shows a blue streak and a swath ending in floating cards; 8 still the weakest (avatar figure, plank kerb, a diagonal light cone artifact). 7 the best frame; 5 and 6 solid.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: Spine holds: one palette and grade, constant type furniture, east right, a real camera move. The accent is weaker than claimed: no gold on the cover, warm limestone on 7 reads as gold, salmon outline on 9; frame 4 sits outside the rendered worlds.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Slide numerals trace to cited claims and art counts are asserted in code. Slide 5 states R squared is a fit, slide 8 the ecological limit. The clusters on 6 rest on the lead author's interview wording.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, method, finding and limit are clear. No county, body, action or deadline; the civic stake lives only in the caption.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The cover earns the swipe, 2 pays, 8 is a real turn, 9 closes on purpose. 3 restates the cover's satellite.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Careful, on register, no doom. 'Drawn to illustrate' on all nine reads mechanical; 9's dek is four stacked sentences; no place named below central Texas.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Topic, palette and land treatment fresh; the extruded slab cover is a familiar opener; 7 and 9 echo November 14th's relief move.

ship_note: No fault found. Under the round 2 rung of 7.7, a work order for round 3.
one_sentence_fix: Rebuild frame 8 around a sculpted rim-lit resident and a true #E0956A kerb seated in cut turf that visibly turns a corner before the house, and delete the diagonal light cone.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Avatar resident with clumped hair; kerb lies on the grass like a plank with blades piercing it; the turned corner a hairline above the house; a diagonal light cone artifact upper right.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Sink the kerb into a cut turf channel with contact shadow, lower the camera about 0.2 m so the corner turns in front of the house, remove the cone volume, keep the figure in silhouette.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Flat elevation, bands read as glossy UI buttons; SO2 shadow a lump outside the right rail; strata with little height.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Keep the SO2 shadow inside the column, give the strata lips real height in place of flat band texture.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A blurred blue streak at right; the swath ends in floating cards and hits nothing; foil reads as crinkled paper.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Delete the streak, let the swath bleed off the bottom edge onto the sweep with a warm glow, finer specular crinkle with a cool rim.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The air sheet renders as clear glass with no gold; primitive satellite.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A transmissive #E0956A tint at about 0.35 opacity casting a warm shadow on the counties.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Navy type wash reads as a rounded plate; tree sprites on a hard fog line; flat caliche.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A vertical gradient wash fading to zero by y 760, horizon scrub in ground haze, scatter and tyre ruts on the caliche.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Vitrines fill a third of the height over an empty reflection floor; dark blobs behind kicker and counter.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Dolly in so the vitrines fill y 820 to 1800, crop the floor, drop the blobs.
